title: Pi config.json
description: Schema for Pi-side configuration read from ~/.pi/config.json.

env.description: Pi-side environment variables. Real environment variables override these values.

PI_X_IDE_AUTO_INSTALL.description: Controls VS Code-family extension auto-install. Values 0, false, and off disable it.

PI_X_IDE_ZED_DB.description: Override path to Zed's SQLite database.

TERM_PROGRAM.description: Terminal program marker used to detect VS Code, Cursor, Windsurf, or Zed.

VSCODE_CWD.description: VS Code-family cwd marker and IDE path hint.

VSCODE_IPC_HOOK_CLI.description: VS Code-family IPC marker and IDE path hint.

VSCODE_GIT_IPC_HANDLE.description: VS Code-family Git IPC marker and IDE path hint.

ZED_TERM.description: Zed terminal marker. Pi x IDE detects Zed when this is true.

WSL_DISTRO_NAME.description: WSL distribution name used for WSL path normalization and Zed database discovery.

WSL_INTEROP.description: WSL interop marker used for WSL path normalization and Zed database discovery.

LOCALAPPDATA.description: Windows local application data directory used to find Zed's database.

USERPROFILE.description: Windows user profile directory used to find Zed's database when LOCALAPPDATA is unavailable.

PATH.description: Executable search path used to find code, cursor, and windsurf CLIs.

Path.description: Windows-style executable search path used to find code, cursor, and windsurf CLIs.

path.description: Lowercase executable search path used to find code, cursor, and windsurf CLIs.

PATHEXT.description: Windows executable extensions used when searching for IDE CLIs.

^(CURSOR|WINDSURF|CODEIUM).*.description: IDE-specific marker used to detect Cursor or Windsurf terminals.
